objective: Improve final-budget validation macro subfield Dice across all four models. FN/FP tradeoffs are acceptable; spatial/error diagnostics explain outcomes, not independent success gates.
correction: The older 55-58% coverage was for internal subfield swaps, not foreground/background errors. Older external-error coverage was88.5-93.4%; current-run spatial coverage remains unmeasured.

proposal.mask_definition: G = (label>0); P = (argmax_c detached logits>0); E = G XOR P; B = original two-step GT union band.
proposal.arm_A: Same B, bounded error emphasis w=1+2*E (3x weight on actual external mistakes). Same grouped BCE, normalize weights separately on GT foreground and background sides, average sides/cases as before.
proposal.arm_B: Same weighting/loss as A; support S=B union one-step six-connected dilation(E), including E itself. Local additions cover every current training FN/FP by construction, including remote FP islands and missed regions. This is boundary supervision plus error regions, not a thin contour-only objective.
proposal.detach: Mask/weights constructed without autograd from current augmented training predictions and labels; no validation input, no labels needed at inference.
proposal.defaults: One-step halo and3x error weight are predeclared pilot choices, not established optima. No simultaneous gradient-target sweep.
proposal.safety_scope: Preserve existing prefix/ramp, base losses, optimizer/LR family, augmentation, folds/seeds and common optimization cap. Profile dynamic mask/loss cost and adjust horizon to cap. Measure gradient-ratio drift; no automatic strength increase.
proposal.initialization: Keep original band anchor active so corrected regions remain supervised; bounded weight ratio avoids unlimited emphasis on a few difficult voxels.

execution_order: Four exact baseline diagnostic replays, logging spatial error/distance/gradient allocation at25/50/75/100% budget; no recipe changes.
Eight new pilot runs: A and B for each model. Reuse current baseline/original-bands performance controls; include UNETR class-aware70.66% as an additional comparator.
Rank by absolute final-budget validation macro Dice, regardless of whether FN or FP individually increases. Recheck promising recipes across three folds and seeds before concluding a reliable gain.
diagnostics: distance bins1,2,3,4,>4 morphology steps from GT outer contour
missed regions and disconnected false-positive regions
training gradient energy on actual mistakes versus correct voxels
per-class and union Dice, train/validation curves
paired corrected/introduced error counts where predictions remain temporarily available
cleanup: Archive counts, distance tables, curves, example overlays, calibration and source before deleting completed checkpoints/predictions. Retain temporary comparison dependencies only until paired analysis finishes.
limits: Coverage by construction on training predictions does not imply better validation Dice.
Early poor predictions can make adaptive support broad; side-normalization and original warmup must be preserved and support size logged.
External errors remain a proxy target; macro subfield Dice is the optimization-selection criterion.
